decisions.rationale: Head nearly in profile and in line with the body (best for a quadruped rig); all four legs separated. b and c turn the head to camera.

The accepted r1 sheep recooked unchanged except for its textures: 512 px base colour, normal and ORM (baked at 1024) instead of 1024 px, to keep the version 3 world within its 160 MiB texture memory as castle surfaces and remains were added (16 to 4 MiB). 371,412 bytes. Same 5,895 triangles, rig and five clips; reviewed in four views beside the soldier, where a sheep is at most about 90 px tall at the closest camera.
limitations: Fleece detail is softer at 512 px when the camera is at its closest.
Clips are procedural (IK gaits, oscillators), not motion capture.
TRELLIS-derived: research and evaluation licence terms, no commercial clearance.

decisions.rationale: Flocks of 5-9 graze, wander, startle and flee from the hero in every settlement pasture as before; at gameplay cameras the 512 px textures read the same as the 1024 px ones.
limitations: No blending between grazing and walking; fleece is a TRELLIS texture with no fur shading.
